title: HypervisorMachineSnapshot
description: RESTORE MATERIAL, AND NEVER RESTORE VALIDITY. Canon separates the two deliberately: snapshot bytes may live on local disk, object storage, CAS or provider storage, and none of that makes a restore valid — validity stays operation-backed. Both generations are recorded because a snapshot taken mid-transition is honest only if it says so.

taken_at_observed_generation.description: Recorded beside the desired generation. A gap means the snapshot was taken while the machine was still converging, and a reader must be able to see that.

boot_epoch.description: The boot epoch this was made under. An attachment does not survive a new epoch merely because the machine persists — a machine that rebooted is not still holding what it held before unless something said so again.

restore_material_only.description: A const rather than a boolean, because there is no admitted record where this is false. Snapshot bytes are never restore validity.
